files.purpose: Pure string helpers: whitespace (explicit Unicode list), line breaks (\r, \n, \r\n, U+2028/2029), line-start tables, line/offset<->position, trim ranges, ASCII-only IsLetter/IsDigit/IsHexDigit. Heavily used by lexer, KustoCode and CommandGrammar.

files.justification: Only referenced from CommandGrammar.cs (28,45,499). Command grammar support.

files.purpose: The lexer. files.justification: Required: first stage of KustoCode.Parse (KustoCode.cs:153). Mirror as-is.

files.purpose: Hand-written recursive-descent parser for Kusto queries: expressions, pipe operators, ~60 query operators with per-operator parameter maps, function bodies, literals, schemas, graph operators. This is the DEFAULT parser used by KustoCode.Parse (ParserKind.Default). Falls back to QueryGrammar via StackSafeParser when depth > MaxDepth (300).
traps: MaxDepth=300 (141) with StackSafeParse (166-195): recursion depth behavior is observable; Java default stack may need explicit depth guard or larger thread stack

~35 static IReadOnlyDictionary<string,QueryOperatorParameter> maps (1974, 3447, 3824-6025); built by CreateQueryOperatorParameterMap (3450) via Dictionary; confirm lookup-only and string keys case-sensitivity (default Dictionary => ordinal)
Static HashSet<SyntaxKind> keyword-as-identifier sets (447,2439) and s_knownQueryOperaterParameterNames (3480)
char.IsDigit(number.Text[0]) (1384,1449,1466)
string.Equals(..., OrdinalIgnoreCase) (2278)
#if false dead block 1417-1442 (ParseNumericLiteral) - drop
Static initialization order across many s_* maps referencing QueryOperatorParameters statics - possible class-init cycle with KustoFacts (see KustoFacts lazy list)
private fields _safeParser/_safeOutput/_safeQueryGrammar (150-161): requires combinator StackSafeParser port
Large switch/pattern code on SyntaxKind - Java switch on enum fine; 7000 lines may exceed 64KB method limit only in giant methods - check ParseQueryOperator style switch
Uses GlobalState.Default.WithParseOptions (176) inside parser: parser->GlobalState dependency
files.justification: THE default parse path. Must be ported 1:1. The stack-safe fallback requires QueryGrammar+combinators; can be stubbed initially with a depth-limit diagnostic.

files.purpose: Parser-combinator grammar for the full query language (QueryBlock, Statement, Expression, all operators). Legacy/alternate parser selected by ParserKind.Grammar and the stack-safe fallback of QueryParser; also the source of completion metadata for IntelliSense (148 CompletionKind uses). KustoCode.Create:217 builds QueryGrammar.From(globals).QueryBlock for every non-command parse even though QueryParser is used by default.
bridgeOnly: 4098 comment only: 'keep this blank line separation before the #endregion to keep BRIDGE.Net from crashing' (no #if)
traps: Initialize() (line ~103-4098) is one enormous method building ~hundreds of local Parser variables with forward-declared nulls; Java 64KB method bytecode limit WILL be exceeded - must split into several methods/fields
Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref s_currentGrammar,...) (58) -> AtomicReference
Grammar cache keyed by ParseOptions.EqualExceptForParseKind (30)
Static Dictionary<SyntaxKind,SyntaxKind> StringOperatorMap (4042)
string.Equals OrdinalIgnoreCase (1735)
char.IsDigit (694)
Grammar results are ordered-choice (First/Or) - semantics depend on combinator implementation; behavioral parity with QueryParser is test-checked upstream
Rule(...) lambdas build syntax nodes with arity up to ~10 (generic delegate overloads in Parsers<T>)
files.justification: Not used on default path except (a) eager construction in KustoCode.Create (avoidable), (b) QueryParser depth>300 fallback, (c) ParserKind.Grammar and tests. Recommend: defer; port later (strip Editor completion annotations) only if deep-nesting fallback or grammar-vs-parser parity tests are required. Initially stub QueryBlock access and skip grammar construction.
